limitations: Numeric limits were fixed by operator under existing authorization; no new PO numeric-budget declaration was invented.
Single round against mixed-attempt history cannot establish causal gain, stability, cold/warm latency, cost or production performance.
Requested model alias is known; observed immutable model/sampler/cost and hardware resource telemetry are unknown.
Additional materiality questions in blocked cases need fresh human judgment; no historical approvals transferred.
No model promotion, paid API service, fallback, training or story completion.
review_note: Checked protocol selection, inventory and typed artifacts with preserved raw final responses and receipts. Initial semantic not-run states retained; model auditor is advisory only.
summary: Frozen protocol and executed one development-only round under existing PO continuation/subscription authorization with operator-fixed limits: 16 serial calls, eight valid generations and audits, no retries, repair or holdout. 74 findings/24 components and nine advisory omissions; no negative advisory components. All eight output snapshots changed and initial assessments are not-run. Two objective PO questions remain pending.
title: Rodada corretiva v3.3 com orçamento fixado e revisão independente por snapshot
